Teeth-Grinding {{tt|Hagigishiri|Bruxish}}!'') is the 15th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Professor Kukui]] takes {{adv|Sun}} and {{adv|Moon}} to [[Ula'ula Island]] on his yacht. * Using [[Mantine Surf]], [[Professor Burnet]] and [[Lillie]] meet up with Kukui's group. * A wild {{p|Bruxish}} attacks everyone, causing the group to get knocked out. * Sun defeats Bruxish with {{p|Wishiwashi|Quarter}} and rescues Lillie, but the two end up separated from the others and end up on an Ula'ula beach. * [[Acerola]] finds Sun and Lillie and takes them to the [[Aether House]] to recuperate. * After Sun and Lillie properly introduce themselves to each other, Sun realizes that Acerola is a [[Trial Captain|captain]]. * Moon, Kukui, and Burnet end up rescued by the [[Aether Foundation]] and are taken to [[Aether Paradise]] to rest up. * Moon's group is greeted by [[Faba]] and [[Wicke]], who offer to give them a tour of Aether Paradise. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * [[Acerola]] * [[Faba]] * [[Wicke]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Bruxish}} * {{p|Sandygast}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Sun}} * {{adv|Moon}} * [[Professor Kukui]] * [[Professor Burnet]] * [[Lillie]] * [[Lana]] (flashback) * [[Kiawe]] (flashback) * [[Mallow]] (flashback) * [[Acerola]] * [[Faba]] * [[Wicke]] * {{tc|Aether Foundation Employee}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Wishiwashi}} (Quarter;
